name: Feng Shuang
source:
A grade‑skipping prodigy and student‑council president. To her, everything in the world reads like a problem: either solvable, or… not yet solved.
She shares no known history with Chen You, yet she always appears precisely at the moments when he does "certain things". Her timing is so uncanny that one cannot help suspecting it is intentional — though she firmly denies it.
Her logic is impeccable, and her judgments almost never fail. Still, in brief, fleeting moments, she will pause and stare into the distance, as if sensing something crucial is missing.
A deviation she has computed countless times, yet can never fully verify.
